info.name: Cyware Intel Exchange (CTIX) v3 Open Reports API

params.name: type
params.description: Pass the type of report to filter reports.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve reports.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of reports to retrieve on each page.

params.name: repeat_type
params.description: Pass the frequency of the report run schedule.

params.name: shared_type
params.description: Pass the visibility of the reports.

params.name: created_by
params.description: Pass the ID of the user who created the reports. You can retrieve the ID using the **Get Users** endpoint.

params.name: modified_by
params.description: Pass the ID of the user who modified the reports. You can retrieve the ID using the **Get Users** endpoint.

params.name: created_from
params.description: Pass the created from time of the reports in epoch format.

params.name: created_to
params.description: Pass the created to time of the reports in epoch format.

params.name: modified_from
params.description: Pass the modified from time of the reports in epoch format.

params.name: modified_to
params.description: Pass the modified to time of the reports in epoch format.

params.name: date_last_run_from
params.description: Pass the last run from time of the reports in epoch format.

params.name: date_last_run_to
params.description: Pass the last run to time of the reports in epoch format.

items.docs: Returns a list of reports from the Intel Exchange application.

params.name: type
params.description: Pass the type of report to be created.

items.docs:
Create a basic (standard) report in Intel Exchange.

Do not use this endpoint to create advanced reports.

params.name: type
params.description: Pass the type of report to be retrieved.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve records.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

params.name: report_id
params.description:
Pass the ID of a report.
For example: *87c07bb3-b60c-4279-a5ec-8a38f73f7ea4*

items.docs: Returns the details of a report.

params.name: report_id

items.docs:
Updates specific fields of a report.

Do not use this endpoint to update advanced reports.

params.name: type
params.description: Pass the type of report to be deleted.

params.name: report_id
params.description: Pass the ID of the report to delete. For example: *87c07bb3-b60c-4279-a5ec-8a38f73f7ea4*

items.docs: Delete a report from the Intel Exchange application. You can only delete reports that are created by you. Retrieve the `report_id` using **List Reports** or **Report Details** APIs.

params.name: token
params.description: Pass the unique token to authorize the request.

params.name: file_id
params.description: Pass the external file ID to download. Example, *3cd05d6d-3ed4-49ae-8866-4d8f87542fa1*
